# Magento UI Library

> Human and AI-readable map of the Magento UI Library documentation website.

## Summary
Magento UI Library provides reusable LESS mixins, variables, and UI implementation examples for Magento frontend themes.

## Primary URL
https://magento2-ui-library.rafaelcg.com/
